# Taaluka

> Taaluka is a local discovery platform connecting residents with local businesses, services, jobs, offers, local updates, events, and community — bringing everything together in one digital platform for every taluka.
>
> Taaluka is currently launched and operational in Akole Taluka, Maharashtra, India, with a vision to expand across all talukas in India.

## About

Taaluka helps residents discover local businesses, access services, explore job opportunities, find offers, stay informed about local updates and events, and connect with their communities.
